description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Status of the owner's businesses and applications, pending requests count, a new name waiting for Awning's review (pending_rename), unfinished draft. Use it first when the owner signs in or asks how things stand; business_id values for the other owner tools come from here. Not for bookings (owner_list_bookings).

business_id.description: Which business, when the owner runs several: business_id from owner_status. Leave out when there is only one.
